session-ratings.App.Title: Chapter Ratings
session-ratings.App.EmptyPlayer: The GM will add a chapter and open voting at the end of the session.
session-ratings.Settings.Criteria.Name: Rating criteria
session-ratings.Settings.Criteria.Hint: Comma-separated list of criteria. Each is rated 1–10. Applies to new chapters.
session-ratings.Form.Title: Chapter title
session-ratings.Confirm.DeleteBody: Delete chapter "{title}" and all its ratings? This cannot be undone.
session-ratings.Voters.Title: Ratings: {title}
session-ratings.Vote.Title: Rate the chapter
session-ratings.Vote.Editing: You already voted — you can change your rating.
session-ratings.Notify.VotingOpen: Voting is open — players received the rating window.
session-ratings.Key.Title: Encryption key
session-ratings.Key.Note: Player ratings are stored in the world encrypted. Only this key can decrypt them — it lives in your browser only and is never sent over the network. Copy it and keep it somewhere safe.
session-ratings.Key.NoneYet: The key is created with your first chapter or first vote.
session-ratings.Key.ImportHint: paste a key from another machine
session-ratings.Key.Warn: If you lose the key, the per-player breakdown cannot be recovered (world averages survive). Importing replaces the current key.
session-ratings.Key.CannotDecrypt: Could not decrypt the ratings: this machine has no matching key. Import it via "Encryption key".
